args.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import compress,zlib
from collections import Counter
rows=open('corpus.txt','rb').read().splitlines(keepends=True)
class Bits:
 def __init__(self):self.data=bytearray();self.pos=0
 def put(self,x,n):
  for k in range(n-1,-1,-1):
   if self.pos%8==0:self.data.append(0)
   self.data[-1]|=((x>>k)&1)<<(7-self.pos%8);self.pos+=1
mask=Bits();lengths=Bits();number=0
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
 prefix=f'{i:05d} '.encode();suffix=f' {i*7%89}\n'.encode()
 if not row.startswith(prefix) or not row.endswith(suffix):print('bad line',i);break
 text=row[len(prefix):-len(suffix)]
 if text==compress.BASE[i%6]:mask.put(0,1);continue
 words=text.split(b' ')
 if not 3<=len(words)<=9 or any(w not in compress.INDEX for w in words):print('bad word',i,words);break
 mask.put(1,1);lengths.put(len(words)-3,3)
 for w in words:number=number*7+compress.INDEX[w]
else:
 digits=number.to_bytes(max(1,(number.bit_length()+7)//8),'big');payload=bytes(mask.data)+bytes(lengths.data)+digits
 print('candidate size',len(zlib.compress(payload,9))+6,'raw',len(payload),'chunks',len(mask.data),len(lengths.data),len(digits))
PY
